title: Vibrant Herbal Venezuelan Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing and exotic dish featuring herbal flavors and Venezuelan seasonings, this fish ceviche is perfect for adventurous eaters, and it is low in fat and calories. The addition of bhuna spice blend gives it a unique twist.

ingredients.name: mixed herbal leaves
ingredients.notes: such as parsley, basil, and dill

instructions: Cut the halibut fillets into small pieces and place them in a large bowl.
Pour the lime juice over the fish and make sure that all the pieces are coated with the juice.
Add the bhuna spice blend, mixed herbal leaves, red onion, and yellow pepper to the bowl and stir gently.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the fish to marinate.
Just before serving, stir the ceviche gently and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the ceviche in small glasses or cups, garnished with additional herbal leaves if desired.
